description: Figure 1 (right) is a line plot illustrating a loss comparison between two models (Vanilla Transformer and SepLLM) as a function of training time. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 250,000 seconds with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 50,000, 100,000, 150,000, 200,000, and 250,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 2.45 to 2.75 with tick labels at about 2.45, 2.50, 2.55, 2.60, 2.65, 2.70, and 2.75. Two solid lines are shown: a purple line labeled “Vanilla” and a red line labeled “SepLLM,” with no visible point markers. Both lines start near the top of the axis around a loss of roughly 2.75 at very small training times and decrease steeply early on, then continue decreasing more gradually toward the right edge; by 250,000 seconds, the purple Vanilla line is near about 2.52 while the red SepLLM line is near about 2.50. A green dashed horizontal reference line is drawn at approximately loss 2.55, and a green dashed vertical reference line is drawn near 250,000 seconds; a green annotation near the right side reads “1.26x.”
